messages:
hao: Heads-up: next week we GA 'Data Access Protocol (DAP)' for Private/VPC customers. It's the umbrella for signed/exportable artifacts + consent/retention controls. Opt-in, requires signed addendum.

hao: TL;DR: agent v3.2+ or later; DAP bundles are encrypted, HSM-signed, and include a manifest + chunking. Default retention on exported artifacts is 30 days unless tenant requests otherwise in contract.

meera: Ops summary: canary Tue 09:00Z -> broad Wed. Limits: 1 active DAP export per tenant, 50GB max per bundle (supports chunking), 3 exports/hour per org. We'll surface a console throttle and per-tenant pause.

legal: Uploaded draft addendum: /legal/templates/dap-export-addendum.md. Legal requirement: admin consent + recorded approver identity for any export that includes telemetry.

platform-bot: deploy-schedule: DAP canary scheduled 2026-07-12T09:00Z -> 2026-07-12T11:00Z. Auto-rollback if error rate >1%.

samir: Security note: artifacts will be signed with an HSM-wrapped key. We'll publish a verification public key and a CRL for revoked signer keys. Include SHA256 checksums in manifests.

anya: Customer API example (private-console):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://private-console.redwood.example/api/v1/tenants/ORG/dap_export" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"since":"2026-03-01T00:00:00Z","profiles":["pci","config"],"include_telemetry":false}'
```

ops: Runbook items: add sections for aborting stuck exports, reassembling chunked bundles, verifying signatures, refreshing agent KMS creds, and temporary throttle knob. Also add disk/memory preflight to agent upgrade.

meera: SLA note: exports are background best-effort. Expected windows: <=24h for <10GB, <=72h for larger. Expedited reviews available via legal-approval token (separate addendum). No change to inference SLOs.

hao: Action items: Legal finalize addendum; Ops add pause/throttle + runbook; Infra publish verification key + CRL; CS prep consent UX + customer checklist. Please ack in-thread when done.

meera: Ack from Ops. I'll schedule office hours for customers and request a demo tenant.

legal: Ack. I'll finalize wording and add instructions for capturing admin identity.

samir: Ack. I'll publish verification key and CRL endpoint.

hao: Thanks all. DM me if you need an early demo tenant or want to rehearse the customer flow. :white_check_mark:
